personalized_email_body:
Hi Freya Soapworks team,

I was looking at your Rhode Island bath products and liked how the zodiac-themed soaps sit alongside gift options like the Chakra gift set. With the holiday season approaching, sets like that can draw down several single-bar SKUs at once, which makes stock counts easy to lose track of.

I build Shopify automation systems that simplify inventory updates, order processing and supplier notifications. One idea for you: when a gift set sells, automatically deduct the individual soaps it contains and send a low-stock alert before any of those bars runs short.

Do your gift sets currently draw from the same stock as your single bars?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist
